strongest_attack: FND-0061 CE-obstruction identification versus mere degree/Serre control of H^0(ω⊗W_f^∨(Γ)): without those groups being exactly the Casnati–Ekedahl evaluation obstruction spaces, claim (b)’s leap from deg-0 triviality to “evaluation-failure locus Z^{bal} = AJ incidence” would be only a line-bundle statement. Outcome: attack fails against the theorem as stated. Adjudicated FND-0063 already packages the CE obstruction-summand language and the fibrewise evaluation-fails-iff O(Γ)≅L equivalence; the theorem claims only set-theoretic equality (FND-0046) and explicitly leaves determinantal/Fitting scheme comparison open. Secondary attack—Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) when the preamble equips B^{bal} with ordered marks—exposes notation overload (stack base vs already-marked stack) but does not refute the intended FND-0064 stack torsor over the reduced-support open; no coarse or integral descent is claimed.
theorem_statement: Let B^{bal} be the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 curves C equipped with a degree-4 cover π: C → P^1 having balanced splitting F ≅ O_{P^1}(4) ⊕ O_{P^1}(5) and six distinct ordered marked points p_1,...,p_6. Let Γ = p_1+...+p_6 and let W_5 = (O_{P(E^∨)}(2) ⊗ γ^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C be the f_2=5 Casnati–Ekedahl line bundle. Then: (a) the f=4 CE evaluation-obstruction summand ω_C ⊗ W_4^∨(Γ) has degree −4 and hence H^0 vanishes identically on B^{bal}; (b) the f=5 CE evaluation-obstruction summand ω_C ⊗ W_5^∨(Γ) has degree 0, so the evaluation-failure locus Z^{bal} ⊂ B^{bal} is set-theoretically the Abel–Jacobi incidence locus {(C,π,Γ) : O_C(Γ) ≅ L := W_5 ⊗ ω_C^{−1}}; (c) the forgetful map from the ordered configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the reduced-support open of the relative effective degree-6 divisor space is a finite étale S_6-torsor; (d) on each geometric fibre, χ(L) = 1 and h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) where M = ω_C^2 ⊗ W_5^∨ has degree 4. The identification of Z^{bal} as a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6}, the constancy of h^0(L) = 3 on the whole balanced locus, the scheme-structure comparison between the determinantal and Abel–Jacobi loci, and the nonemptiness of the reduced-support ordered incidence on every geometric fibre remain open gaps.
